name: Elementa Spaces
author: makehasteslowly
description: Your workspaces as the five elements, in four traditions with their own design language: Elemental (fire, water, earth, air, aether), Alchemical symbols, Japanese Godai and Chinese Wu Xing. The bar marks the workspace you are on, the ones with windows and the empty ones; hover for a live preview of its windows, and a workspace blinks when one of its apps wants your attention. No dependencies, no network.

barWidget.description: Workspaces as the five elements, with live previews on hover and alert blinking.

schema.label: Symbol Style
schema.description: Choose between Nerd Font elemental icons (󰈸 󰖌 󰋵 󰖝 󰫢), Alchemical symbols (🜂 🜄 🜃 🜁 ✧), Japanese Godai (地 水 火 風 空), or Chinese Wu Xing (木 火 土 金 水). Right-click the widget on the bar to switch anytime.

options.label: 󰈸  Elemental Icons (Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Aether)
地  Japanese Godai (地 水 火 風 空)
木  Chinese Wu Xing (木 火 土 金 水)

schema.label: Icon Colors
schema.description: Choose between Soft elemental colors, Bold high-saturation elemental colors, or the active Omarchy theme's own colors.

schema.label: Floating Preview Size
schema.description: Choose the size of the floating workspace preview window shown on hover (Small, Medium, Large, or Off).

schema.label: Alert Blink
schema.description: Control the fade/blink speed when an app on an inactive workspace receives a notification (Off, Slow, Medium, or Fast).
